DEPARTMENT OF FORESTS AND WILDLIFE
NOTIFICATION
Delhi, the 25th May, 2026
F. No. 2(1)/DCF(W)/CR SEC 20/P1/2025-26/2626-35.—WHEREAS, a notification for declaration to
constitute such lands in, inter alia, Central Ridge in NCT of Delhi, a reserved forest in pursuance of the provisions of
Section-4 of Indian Forest Act, 1927 (Act No. 16 of 1927) was published in the Delhi Gazette: Extraordinary Part-IV,
vide Notification of the Government of NCT of Delhi in the Development Department vide number F.10 (42)-
I/PA/DCF/93/2012-17(1), dated 24th May, 1994;
AND WHEREAS, a notification for appointment of Additional District Magistrate (HQ), Additional District
Magistrate (South District) and Additional District Magistrate (South-West District) to be Forest Settlement Officer as
provided in Chapter-II of the said Act was published in the Delhi Gazette: Extraordinary Part-IV, vide Notification of
the Government of NCT of Delhi in the Department of Environment, Forests and Wildlife vide number F.10 (42)-
I/PA/DCF/93/II/181-198, dated 10th May, 2006;
AND Whereas, as per notification no. 15-7(5173)/02 dated 19.05.2004 of Ministry of Urban Development &
Poverty Alleviation, Government of India an area of 423 ha out of 864 ha in Central Ridge was handed over to the
Department of Forests & Wildlife, GNCTD on as is where is basis in pursuance of the directions of Hon’ble Supreme
Court of India in Writ Petition No. 4677/1985 regarding protection of the Delhi Ridge area.

8 DELHI GAZETTE : EXTRAORDINARY PART IV]
AND WHEREAS, in compliance with the directions of the Hon’ble National Green Tribunal, vide Order
dated 11.03.2019 in Original Application No. 58 of 2013, a detailed joint status report on demarcation over Forest
Land falling in the Central Ridge in NCT of Delhi through Differential GPS, along with Land & Development Office,
Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, GoI, Delhi Development Authority and Department of Forest & Wildlife,
GNCTD, inter alia, reported that though an area of 423 ha had earlier been handed over to the Department of Forests
& Wildlife, GNCTD, the ground demarcation exercise carried out through Differential GPS revealed that an area of
607.575 ha is under the clear possession of the Department of Forests & Wildlife, GNCTD and 65.745 ha under the
clear possession of DDA, totaling 673.32 ha, over which no claims are pending, and that any land comprised within
such limits as specified in the Schedule to this notification was duly demarcated; and duly signed Survey Maps were
annexed therewith;
AND WHEREAS, the Forest Settlement Officer has inquired into and determined that no right exists in
favour of any person in or over any land comprised within such limits as specified in the Schedule to this notification,
or in or over any forest-produce therein; and has certified that no claims or appeals thereof are pending as provided in
Chapter-II of the said Act in or over any land comprised within such limits;
AND WHEREAS, such adjoining lands as specified in the Schedule to this notification have been constituted
into individual blocks for the purpose of this notification within such limits as indicated with solid green coloring in
the Annexure – I (Central Ridge Map) along with the corresponding list of geo-co-ordinates of the boundary end-
points of the blocks indicated in the Annexure – II to this notification;
AND WHEREAS, the notification(s) under section 20 of the said Act, in respect of remaining areas, of such
lands declared to constitute as reserved forest in pursuance of the provisions of Section-4 of the said Act vide
Notification of the Government of NCT of Delhi in the Development Department vide number F.10 (42)-
I/PA/DCF/93/2012-17(1), dated 24th May, 1994, will be notified shortly;
NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by the Section 20 of the Indian Forest Act, 1927
(Act No. 16 of 1927), read with the Government of India, Ministry of Home Affairs, Notification Nos. 104-J and 146-
J dated 24th August, 1950 and 06th December, 1950 respectively, and read with S.R.O. No 2536 dated 01st
November, 1956, the Lt. Governor of the National Capital Territory of Delhi is pleased to hereby declare such lands
as specified in the Schedule below, as Reserved Forest, with effect from the date of publication of the Notification in
the Official Gazette.
